label: m³ calculator
kop: How much are you taking abroad?
intro: Count your belongings room by room. Have more rooms or items of your own? Add them. You see straight away how many cubic metres that is and which transport suits it: groupage, a lorry of your own or a container of your own. Your count goes into Comments on the quote form and is only sent if you submit that form yourself.
noscript: This calculator uses JavaScript, and that is switched off in your browser. Call our adviser instead and go through what is moving with you.
leeg: Count something and you will see here how many cubic metres it is and which transport suits it.

groupage_weg.tekst: Groupage is possible at any volume. Your shipment travels on a shared lorry, with other cargo heading the same way. The smaller the shipment, the sooner it can usually go.

groupage_zee.tekst: Groupage is possible at any volume. Your belongings share a container with other cargo going to the same destination. The smaller the shipment, the sooner it can usually go.

groupage_beide.tekst: Groupage is possible at any volume, by road and overseas. Your shipment shares space with other cargo heading the same way. The smaller the shipment, the sooner it can usually go.

vrachtwagen.tekst: Your belongings travel as a full load in a lorry of your own, with no one else's cargo on board. During the survey, we work out with you which lorry suits your volume.

c20.tekst: A 20 ft container holds about 33 m³. Your belongings fill it to {pct}%.

c40.tekst: A 40 ft container holds about 67 m³. Your belongings fill it to {pct}%.

c40hc.titel: Your own 40 ft high cube container
c40hc.tekst: A high cube is one foot taller than a standard container. A 40 ft high cube container holds about 76 m³. Your belongings fill it to {pct}%.

c45.titel: Your own 45 ft high cube container
c45.tekst: A 45 ft high cube container holds about 86 m³. Your belongings fill it to {pct}%.

meer.tekst: Your belongings take up more than one 45 ft high cube container. During the survey, we discuss how the shipment is spread over several containers.

minder_kop: The less you take, the cheaper

minder_naar.c20: With {minder} m³ less, everything fits in a 20 ft container.
minder_naar.c40: With {minder} m³ less, everything fits in a 40 ft container.
minder_naar.c40hc: With {minder} m³ less, everything fits in a 40 ft high cube container.
minder_naar.c45: With {minder} m³ less, everything fits in one 45 ft high cube container.

minder_kleinste: Everything already fits in a 20 ft container. Whatever stays at home need not travel, not even with groupage.
minder_weg: Every cubic metre left at home saves space, with groupage and in your own lorry.
verpakking: The calculator counts the space an item of furniture takes up in the removal van. It is protected for transport, and that protection takes up space too. We set the volume for the quote together with you during the survey.
